title: Zoe spotlight
description: A 24px-rounded product spotlight panel split down the middle: a photo on navy on the left, and on warm cream a chunky, tightly set two-line headline, a short semibold pitch and a navy button. On phones the whole panel turns navy: the headline and a yellow button over the photo (the pitch shows from desktop up).
notes: the phone panel is the foreground colour (card in dark mode); the desktop text half is the accent colour
